scripts.clean:all: rm -rf .turbo && find . -type d \( -name 'node_modules' -o -name '.next' -o -name 'dist' -o -name '.turbo' -o -name '.cache' -o -name 'coverage' -o -name '.nyc_output' \) -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && find . -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -delete && echo '🧹 All caches and build artifacts cleaned!'
scripts.clean:cache: rm -rf .turbo && find . -type d \( -name '.next' -o -name 'dist' -o -name '.turbo' -o -name '.cache' -o -name 'coverage' -o -name '.nyc_output' \) -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && find . -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -delete && echo '🧹 Build caches cleaned!'
scripts.clean:modules: find . -type d -name 'node_modules' -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && echo '📦 All node_modules directories removed!'
scripts.clean:turbo: turbo run clean --concurrency=15 && yarn install --check-cache && yarn workspace @peas/database build && turbo run build --filter=@peas/theme --filter=@peas/tailwind --filter=@peas/features --filter=@peas/components --concurrency=15
